## v0.10.0

**Highlights:** Vireo now notices new commits on your remotes and fetches them in the background, the Release page scales up on large screens, and file icons cover far more file types.

### Remote changes show up on their own

- **Background auto-fetch:** Vireo checks your remotes quietly and runs a real `git fetch` only when a remote's branch heads differ from your local remote-tracking refs. The check is a cheap `git ls-remote --heads`. The UI refreshes by itself when something changes, so you no longer have to press Fetch.
- **Adaptive polling:** it polls every 20 seconds for 5 minutes after the window gains focus or a change is detected, and every 90 seconds otherwise. Hidden windows don't poll, and refocusing checks right away. It also skips repos with no remote and pauses while a git write operation is running.
- **Safe by design:** it never prompts for credentials, never runs `gc` or maintenance, and puts a timeout on every git call (20 s for `ls-remote`, 60 s for `fetch`). Overlapping checks are skipped. If you're offline or authentication fails, it tries again on the next tick without showing an error.

### Release page on large screens

- **Scales with the window:** the Release page and its review dialog grow up to 2× on wide displays (from about 1000 px up), so text and controls no longer look tiny on 4K and ultrawide monitors.
- **Taller content areas:** the scrolling regions and the review dialog use more of the available height as the page scales.

### Many more file icons

- **Broader coverage:** the file tree now has distinct icons for .NET/JVM/native languages, web frameworks and templates, config and data formats, documents, images, design files and fonts, audio and video, archives and packages, compiled/binary artifacts, and certificates and keys.

### Docs

- README download links and SHA-256 checksums now point at v0.9.0 (they were stale at v0.7.0).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0
